+"""Reproduce the reported GTT + external-attachment + different-role sequence."""
+import json
+import os
+import re
+import subprocess
+import sys
+import uuid
+
+
+CHECK_ID = "external_gtt_roles_do_not_bugcheck_167"
+
+
+def run(argv, sql=None, timeout=120):
+    return subprocess.run(
+        argv,
+        input=sql,
+        text=True,
+        capture_output=True,
+        timeout=timeout,
+        check=False,
+    )
+
+
+def sql_literal(value):
+    return "'" + value.replace("'", "''") + "'"
+
+
+def main():
+    dsn = os.environ.get("ACREPAIR_FIREBIRD_DSN")
+    if not dsn:
+        raise RuntimeError("ACREPAIR_FIREBIRD_DSN is required")
+
+    isql = os.environ.get("ACREPAIR_ISQL", "isql")
+    admin = os.environ.get("ACREPAIR_ADMIN_USER", "SYSDBA")
+    password = os.environ.get("ACREPAIR_PASSWORD_" + admin.upper(), "masterkey")
+    suffix = uuid.uuid4().hex[:10].upper()
+    table = "AC_GTT_" + suffix
+    index = "AC_GTT_INDEX_" + suffix
+    roles = ["AC_POOR_ROLE_" + suffix, "AC_COOL_ROLE_" + suffix, "AC_SUPER_ROLE_" + suffix]
+    admin_cmd = [isql, "-user", admin, "-password", password, dsn]
+
+    setup_sql = "SET BAIL ON;\n"
+    setup_sql += f"CREATE GLOBAL TEMPORARY TABLE {table} (X INTEGER, Y INTEGER) ON COMMIT PRESERVE ROWS;\n"
+    for role in roles:
+        setup_sql += f"CREATE ROLE {role};\nGRANT {role} TO {admin};\n"
+    setup_sql += "COMMIT;\n"
+    setup = run(admin_cmd, setup_sql)
+    if setup.returncode != 0:
+        raise RuntimeError("Could not create the GTT/role fixture: " + setup.stdout + setup.stderr)
+
+    role_literals = [sql_literal(role) for role in roles]
+    external_sql = (
+        f"INSERT INTO {table} SELECT RAND()*10, RAND()*10 FROM RDB$TYPES "
+        "UNION ALL SELECT -2, -3 FROM RDB$DATABASE"
+    )
+    quoted_user = sql_literal(admin)
+    quoted_password = sql_literal(password)
+    block = (
+        "SET TRANSACTION READ COMMITTED;\n"
+        "SET TERM ^;\n"
+        "EXECUTE BLOCK AS\n"
+        "  DECLARE V_DBNAME TYPE OF COLUMN MON$DATABASE.MON$DATABASE_NAME;\n"
+        "BEGIN\n"
+        "  V_DBNAME = 'localhost:' || RDB$GET_CONTEXT('SYSTEM', 'DB_NAME');\n"
+        f"  EXECUTE STATEMENT {sql_literal(external_sql)} ON EXTERNAL V_DBNAME "
+        f"AS USER {quoted_user} PASSWORD {quoted_password} ROLE {role_literals[0]};\n"
+        f"  EXECUTE STATEMENT {sql_literal(external_sql)} ON EXTERNAL V_DBNAME "
+        f"AS USER {quoted_user} PASSWORD {quoted_password} ROLE {role_literals[1]};\n"
+        f"  EXECUTE STATEMENT {sql_literal('CREATE INDEX ' + index + ' ON ' + table + ' COMPUTED BY (X+Y)')} "
+        f"WITH AUTONOMOUS TRANSACTION ON EXTERNAL V_DBNAME AS USER {quoted_user} "
+        f"PASSWORD {quoted_password} ROLE {role_literals[1]};\n"
+        f"  EXECUTE STATEMENT {sql_literal(external_sql)} ON EXTERNAL V_DBNAME "
+        f"AS USER {quoted_user} PASSWORD {quoted_password} ROLE {role_literals[2]};\n"
+        "END^\n"
+        "SET TERM ;^\n"
+        "COMMIT;\n"
+    )
+
+    actual = {}
+    try:
+        try:
+            target = run(admin_cmd, "SET BAIL ON;\n" + block, timeout=120)
+            actual = {
+                "phase": "external_gtt_role_sequence",
+                "returncode": target.returncode,
+                "stdout": target.stdout,
+                "stderr": target.stderr,
+            }
+            bugcheck_167 = bool(re.search(
+                r"invalid SEND request\s*\(167\)",
+                target.stdout + target.stderr,
+                re.IGNORECASE,
+            ))
+        except subprocess.TimeoutExpired as exc:
+            actual = {
+                "phase": "external_gtt_role_sequence",
+                "timed_out": True,
+                "stdout": exc.stdout,
+                "stderr": exc.stderr,
+            }
+            print("CHECK_RESULT=" + json.dumps({
+                "harness_error": "TARGET_SEQUENCE_TIMEOUT_WITHOUT_CONFIRMED_BUGCHECK_167",
+                "checks": [{"name": CHECK_ID, "kind": "target", "passed": False,
+                            "actual": actual}],
+                "reproduced": False,
+                "origin": "generated_from_report_sql_and_fbt_fix_reference",
+            }, ensure_ascii=False), flush=True)
+            return
+
+        if target.returncode != 0 and not bugcheck_167:
+            print("CHECK_RESULT=" + json.dumps({
+                "harness_error": "TARGET_SEQUENCE_FAILED_WITHOUT_CONFIRMED_BUGCHECK_167",
+                "checks": [{"name": CHECK_ID, "kind": "target", "passed": False,
+                            "actual": actual}],
+                "reproduced": False,
+                "origin": "generated_from_report_sql_and_fbt_fix_reference",
+            }, ensure_ascii=False), flush=True)
+            return
+
+        passed = target.returncode == 0 and not bugcheck_167
+
+        if passed:
+            try:
+                probe = run(
+                    admin_cmd,
+                    "SET BAIL ON;\nSELECT 1 FROM RDB$DATABASE;\n",
+                    timeout=30,
+                )
+                passed = probe.returncode == 0
+                actual["post_run_connection_probe"] = {
+                    "returncode": probe.returncode,
+                    "stdout": probe.stdout,
+                    "stderr": probe.stderr,
+                }
+            except subprocess.TimeoutExpired as exc:
+                actual["post_run_connection_probe"] = {
+                    "timed_out": True,
+                    "stdout": exc.stdout,
+                    "stderr": exc.stderr,
+                }
+                print("CHECK_RESULT=" + json.dumps({
+                    "harness_error": "POST_RUN_CONNECTION_PROBE_TIMEOUT",
+                    "checks": [{"name": CHECK_ID, "kind": "target", "passed": False,
+                                "actual": actual}],
+                    "reproduced": False,
+                    "origin": "generated_from_report_sql_and_fbt_fix_reference",
+                }, ensure_ascii=False), flush=True)
+                return
+            if not passed:
+                print("CHECK_RESULT=" + json.dumps({
+                    "harness_error": "POST_RUN_CONNECTION_PROBE_FAILED_WITHOUT_CONFIRMED_BUGCHECK_167",
+                    "checks": [{"name": CHECK_ID, "kind": "target", "passed": False,
+                                "actual": actual}],
+                    "reproduced": False,
+                    "origin": "generated_from_report_sql_and_fbt_fix_reference",
+                }, ensure_ascii=False), flush=True)
+                return
+
+        result = {
+            "checks": [
+                {
+                    "name": CHECK_ID,
+                    "kind": "target",
+                    "passed": passed,
+                    "expected": {"sql_sequence_completes": True, "bugcheck_167": False},
+                    "actual": actual,
+                }
+            ],
+            "reproduced": bugcheck_167,
+            "origin": "generated_from_report_sql_and_fbt_fix_reference",
+        }
+        print("CHECK_RESULT=" + json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False), flush=True)
+    finally:
+        cleanup_sql = "SET BAIL OFF;\n"
+        cleanup_sql += f"DROP TABLE {table};\n"
+        for role in roles:
+            cleanup_sql += f"REVOKE {role} FROM {admin};\nDROP ROLE {role};\n"
+        cleanup_sql += "COMMIT;\n"
+        try:
+            run(admin_cmd, cleanup_sql, timeout=30)
+        except (OSError, subprocess.TimeoutExpired):
+            pass
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    try:
+        main()
+    except (OSError, subprocess.TimeoutExpired, RuntimeError) as exc:
+        print("TEST_INFRA_ERROR=" + str(exc), file=sys.stderr, flush=True)
+        sys.exit(2)

problem_statement:
Bugcheck 167 (invalid SEND request) while working with GTT from several attachments (using EXECUTE STATEMENT ... ON EXTERNAL and different roles) [CORE4754]

Submitted by: @pavel-zotov

Attachments:
[fb-abend-after-manupilations-with-GTT-using-ES-in-several-attaches-from-single-execute-block.zip](https://github.com/FirebirdSQL/jira-attachments/raw/main/CORE/CORE-4754/12706_fb-abend-after-manupilations-with-GTT-using-ES-in-several-attaches-from-single-execute-block.zip)

WI\-T3\.0\.0\.31789, reproduced in SuperServer and SuperClassic\.

The following script:

recreate global temporary table gtt\_session\(x int, y int\) on commit preserve rows;
commit;

set transaction read committed;
set term ^;
execute block as \-\- returns\(att\_id int, cnt int, sql\_plan blob, idx\_stat double precision\) as
   declare v\_dbname type of column mon$database\.mon$database\_name;
begin

   v\_dbname = 'localhost:' \|\| rdb$get\_context\('SYSTEM', 'DB\_NAME'\);

   execute statement 'insert into gtt\_session select rand\(\)\*10, rand\(\)\*10 from rdb$types union all select \-2, \-3 from rdb$database'
   on external v\_dbname
   as user 'sysdba' password 'masterke' role 'poor\_dba';

   \-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-

   execute statement 'insert into gtt\_session select rand\(\)\*10, rand\(\)\*10 from rdb$types union all select \-2, \-3 from rdb$database'
   on external v\_dbname
   as user 'sysdba' password 'masterke' role 'cool\_dba';

   execute statement 'create index gtt\_session\_x\_y on gtt\_session computed by \( x\+y \)'
   with autonomous transaction
   on external v\_dbname
   as user 'sysdba' password 'masterke' role 'cool\_dba';

   \-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-

   execute statement 'insert into gtt\_session select rand\(\)\*10, rand\(\)\*10 from rdb$types union all select \-2, \-3 from rdb$database'
   on external v\_dbname
   as user 'sysdba' password 'masterke' role 'super\_dba';

end
^
set term ;^

\-\- leads to:

1\) appearing in firebird\.log message:
===
CSPROG  Fri Apr 17 21:24:38 2015
        Database: C:\\MIX\\firebird\\QA\\fbt\-repo\\tmp\\e30\.fdb
        internal Firebird consistency check \(invalid SEND request \(167\), file: JrdStatement\.cpp line: 325\)
===
2\) appearing 'abend message' on Windows XP with:
2\.1\) singnature of error:
szAppName : firebird\.exe     szAppVer : 3\.0\.0\.31789     szModName : msvcr100\.dll
szModVer : 10\.0\.30319\.415     offset : 0008cb95     
2\.2\) notion about two files \(which have been attached here\): firebird\.exe\.mdmp  and appcompat\.txt 

3\) After this message will appear:
3\.1\) ISQL can not finish script, and can not be interrupted;
3\.2\) no new attaches can be etsablished to any other \.fdb
3\.3\) these ISQLs loads CPU up to 100% and also can not be interrupted \- even after killing firebird process\.

All necessary files please see in attached \.zip
